data.description: 维多利亚风格老宅阁楼卧室，彩色花窗外高悬着冷冽银月。坐在高背天鹅绒单人扶手椅中，双手抱着古老精装魔导书置于膝上，黑发冷艳垂肩，幽冷黑眸静静注视来人，不惊不喜如古潭无波。 她微微抬眸轻语——“在午夜闯入魔女的闺阁……青子没有教过你，这需要付出怎样的代价吗？”
promptTokens: sitting symmetrically in antique wooden chair
data.promptProse: Alice Kuonji sits rigidly upright in an antique high-backed chair in her Victorian attic manor at midnight, framed against stained-glass windows illuminated by a cold silver full moon.
data.animaCaption: Sitting upright in an antique chair before stained-glass attic windows illuminated by a cold midnight moon.
